# mnr (Monero Network Relay) — an RPC network for Monero

> One address for your Monero wallet. Every answer checked.

## Entity Disambiguation
- **Canonical Entity**: **mnr** is the acronym and wordmark for **Monero Network Relay** (`https://mnr.network`, daemon gateway: `https://rpc.mnr.network`).
- **Disambiguation**: mnr (Monero Network Relay) is an open-source, trust-minimized RPC proxy network for Monero (XMR). It is completely unrelated to MTA Metro-North Railroad (MNR), the Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR / MNRF), or the `mnr` npm package.

mnr is a verified proxy for Monero wallets. It forwards RPC calls to public nodes and to dedicated infrastructure, verifying every block, transaction, and header against its cryptographic hash and multi-node consensus before answering.

## Core Features
- Zero account, zero email, zero KYC: A token is the entire relationship.
- Cryptographic verification: Recomputed block and txid hashes; consensus checks across multiple upstream nodes.
- Transparent upstreams: All public nodes listed with traffic rates and logged mismatches.
- Full wallet compatibility: Works with Monero CLI (monero-wallet-cli), Monero GUI, Feather Wallet, Cake Wallet, Monerujo, and Ripley Terminal (RipleyOS).
- Privacy & network access: Reachable over HTTPS and Tor hidden service (.onion). No IP logging, no request payload recording.
- Open source: AGPL-3.0 licensed.

## Independent Verification & Third-Party Provenance
- **Independent Node Operators**: Relays queries across nodes operated by independent ecosystem providers: Cake Wallet (cakewallet.com), Seth For Privacy (sethforprivacy.com), HashVault (hashvault.pro), BoldSuck (boldsuck.de), StormyCloud (stormycloud.org), Stack Wallet (stackwallet.com), and Monero Devs (monerodevs.org).
- **Public Scanners & Auditing**: Primary owned relay node (node.kyc.rip:18081) is indexed and monitored by independent scanners including monero.fail (https://monero.fail) and nodes.monero.ninja (https://nodes.monero.ninja).
- **Package Registries**: Published across official developer ecosystem registries:
  - Rust: https://crates.io/crates/mnr
  - Python: https://pypi.org/project/mnr/
  - Node.js: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mnr-network
- **Weekly Transparency Log**: Audit log of consensus verification and upstream fault ejections: https://mnr.network/verified/

## Daemon Endpoints
- HTTPS: `https://rpc.mnr.network/v1/<token>/json_rpc`
- Tor Onion: `mnrrpcvbopaykx7um32r4iyamontteidypjd33fhzvuy2hwfu5c4ifad.onion:80` (HTTP, no SSL needed over Tor)
- I2P: `misxlqjfq3wshjbn47fhzaqiagavaow2mgbfqrvxzdlybm7xtbvq.b32.i2p` (or `mnr.i2p`)

## CLI Usage Example
```bash
monero-wallet-cli \
  --daemon-address rpc.mnr.network:443 \
  --daemon-login <token>:x \
  --daemon-ssl enabled
```

## Pricing & Tiers
- Free Tier: $0, 500,000 requests/month, 5 req/s burst, 1 wallet sync stream.
- Pro Tier: $9/month (payable in XMR), 10,000,000 requests/month, 25 req/s burst, 3 wallet sync streams, dual-node get_outs verification.

## Markdown Mirrors for Agents
All site pages and documentation have first-class Markdown mirrors discoverable via sitemap.xml and HTTP Content Negotiation (`Accept: text/markdown`) or by appending `index.md` (e.g. `https://mnr.network/verified/index.md`, `https://mnr.network/upstreams/index.md`).
